skills.description: Operate the user's Texo personal knowledge base — a markdown wiki incrementally compiled from their raw fragments (text/voice/photo). One skill, nine operations; ALWAYS read the matching references/<op>.md before acting. compile ('整理我的记录', '编译 wiki'); ingest ('处理新条目'); import (Apple Notes or .md/.txt folders, '导入我的备忘录'); answer (questions about the owner's own records — 'what did I think about X last year', '我去年怎么想的'); recall (mid-task: when ANOTHER task touches a topic the user likely has recorded opinions on, retrieve their real stance as context — use proactively); lint ('检查我的库', contradictions, open loops); review ('生成回顾', monthly/yearly); profile ('生成我的主页', Texopedia); watch ('自动编译' setup/manage). Trigger on any of these even without the word 'texo'.
